discovery_notes: WebFetch to disneystore.com failed (DNS/network policy); all claims are from WebSearch summaries (search_snippet). No new pins found: no Series 4 or LE singles beyond the 6 Oct 2026 wave surfaced. Tod/Todd: Disney Store UK listing (438030648549) and a fan inventory use 'Tod'; US and AU listings and Disney Pins Blog use 'Todd'. Regional codes differ from US codes (e.g. Sorcerer Mickey 438010540955 on Asia/AU; Marie 438010541945 on UK). Asia listings repeat LE 2,250 for Sorcerer Mickey, Maleficent and Hercules; US sources give 3,750 for Hercules, so the Asia figure may be boilerplate. Mystery box prices are per 2-pin box and are recorded at set level only. Disney Mouseketeer says some waves were also at select DLR/WDW locations, another post says DisneyStore.com exclusive - unresolved. Selfridges London (Disney Store at Selfridges) listed a Brush of Magic mystery set from GBP 25; series not stated. Excluded-source data (Pin & Pop, PinPics, PinTradingDB) surfaced in searches and was ignored, incl. a 3,750 figure for the January pins and a Bambi SKU.
